items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 105:1
items.html: (To the question) The Mochin are given to Leah first, because she can receive directly from Aba and Ima, like ZA, and she receives them immediately. Therefore the Gevurot from the chest and above, which are counted as of the degree of ZA himself, are sawed apart immediately, with their ascent as MAN, and are given to Leah, as above in Answer 222, see there. But after the shofar blast, when ZA descends to his place and gives the Mochin to Rachel, for the building of her Partzuf, then the Mochin emerge from Leah and are given to Rachel; and then Rachel necessarily receives the Gevurot from the Keter to the chest, which is the aspect of the Nukva in the body of ZA that Leah had taken beforehand; and now this belongs to Rachel, for she ascends and clothes ZA in an equal stature, up to the Keter. But before ZA descended to his place, Leah received the Mochin and also the Gevurot from the Keter to the chest, namely before the shofar blast, as above. (Part 1, Page 756, s.v. and there is no).
